guarantee: If I can't find at least 3 fixable conversion leaks on your store, you get a full refund. I don't promise a conversion lift, because nobody honestly can. I promise careful work you can see live.

faqs.q: Do you need my Shopify password?
faqs.a: No. You add me as a collaborator from your Shopify admin and approve the access. You can remove it any time.

faqs.q: Will you break my live store during Black Friday?
faqs.a: No. All work happens on a duplicate of your live theme. You preview every change, and it is only published after you say yes.

faqs.q: My store is not on Shopify. Can you still help?
faqs.a: Yes for WooCommerce, BigCommerce and custom builds. Mention your platform in the form and I will confirm what is possible before you pay.
No. Traffic, offer and season all move results. What is guaranteed is the scope: the fixes listed in your package, shipped on time, and a refund if I can't find at least 3 real leaks.

faqs.q: How do I pay and how fast do you start?
faqs.a: Claim a package below. You get a reply with an invoice (PayPal, Wise or card), usually within a couple of hours. Work starts as soon as access and payment are in.
